episodes.synopsis: Nozomi Moritomo is an average girl who just wants to help, but can a lowly Rest like her make a difference in the battle of the Bests?
episodes.title: King of Rookies

episodes.synopsis: Nozomi and the other Hiyoshicho Propellers are trapped on a roller coaster! Can Masami save them without revealing Maccha Green's true identity?
episodes.title: Center of the World

episodes.synopsis: The girls set out to Tokyo to gather Moonlight Stones with Chiaya and find themselves in the middle of "Always Comima."
episodes.title: I Wanna Be a Hero

episodes.synopsis: The girls escape with the help of a Comima staff member, but a new threat appears. Can they clear their names and get Chiaya's stone back?
episodes.title: Dream

episodes.synopsis: Aichi and Mie are up in arms and things are tense after all the shachihoko in Nagoya were blown up. Can the girls bring peace to the warring nations?
episodes.title: Disappointing Person

episodes.synopsis: Chiaya's back, but they lose Yukina as things come to a head in old Aichi and old Mie. How will they ever learn to coexist peacefully?
episodes.title: Lightning Speed

episodes.synopsis: The girls are now in Kyoto, where the captain of the squad they are trying to help is kidnapped. Can they save the captain and the rock festival?!
episodes.title: Give Me the Stars

episodes.synopsis: Misa is back where she belongs, but what happened between her and Mamechiyo? And what is Shuten up to, anyway?
episodes.title: After the Rain

episodes.synopsis: The girls find themselves in Hiroshima by way of Okayama, but can they work through their own troubles and help the locals at the same time?
episodes.title: Thieves of the Night

episodes.synopsis: Ai is taken in by a poor peach grower and her daughter, and Yukina is lost again. Can Nozomi help Kaguya and Kuramochi by herself? And where's Chiaya?
episodes.title: No No No

episodes.synopsis: Things are getting heated up in Okayama, but how is the Nayotake family involved? Will the girls be able to reunite and resolve everything?
episodes.title: Rose of Passion

episodes.synopsis: What can four Rest girls do thrown in amongst Bests and robots and aliens? In the midst of all the fighting, can the girls bring peace?
episodes.title: The Future Is in Our Hands
